// What the Metal translation needs rewritten: ten arguments, a parameter
// named like an argument, a struct constructor, vector != and a C++ keyword.
struct Hit { float d; float c; };
Hit probe(vec3 p, float r) { return Hit(length(p) - r, m); }
float map(vec3 v) {
	vec3 c = floor(i_volume_size * 0.5);
	vec3 cell = floor(v);
	float try = 0.0;
	if (cell != c) try = 1.0;
	Hit h = probe(v - i_volume_size * 0.5, r);
	return h.d <= 0.0 ? h.c + (try - try) : voxel(v);
}
